headline_item.title_zh: 堪萨斯城叫停摩天数据中心项目
headline_item.title_en: Developers Wanted to Build a High-Rise Data Center. Kansas City Blocked It.
headline_item.author: Tiffany Hsu
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 堪萨斯城市议会因社区抗议与规划争议，全票否决了一项拟建的20层高层数据中心开发计划
headline_item.event_summary_en: The Kansas City Council unanimously rejected a proposal to build a 20-story data center in a historic district. The project faced significant local opposition due to concerns over urban footprint, energy consumption, and the demolition of historic landmarks, leading to the rejection after over 400 letters of protest.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】堪萨斯城市议会（Kansas City Council）在美国密苏里州堪萨斯城市中心：全票否决了一项拟拆除历史建筑并改建为20层高密度数据中心的开发计划
【起因与机理】当地居民对数据中心的高耗能属性及垂直化建设模式持强烈抵制态度，且对项目背后的税务激励合理性存疑
【核心事实细节】核心争议在于AI数据中心选址向城市核心区高密度扩张的社会阻力。
【各方立场与态度】城市中心算力基础设施建设面临严峻的合规与公众接纳度考验。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Kansas City Council (Downtown Kansas City, Missouri): Unanimously blocked a proposal to develop a 20-story data center
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Local pushback against high energy demands, urban density concerns, and skepticism regarding private equity tax incentive maneuvers
[Key Metrics] Austin told one trade publication that, at $183 million, he expected construction to exceed the average cost of building a suburban facility.
[Key Position & Outlook] Infrastructure developers face mounting regulatory and social acceptance hurdles for urban compute hubs.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 随着AI算力需求向城市核心区渗透，数据中心选址正从边缘化土地向高密度垂直空间转型，但与传统城市景观的兼容性博弈将成为该产业落地的最大非技术障碍。此案例预示着未来算力基础设施建设需在‘分布式紧凑设计’与‘本地社区环境合规性’之间建立更严苛的平衡机制。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: As AI compute demands migrate toward urban cores, the tension between data center density and municipal urban planning is intensifying. This rejection signals that future infrastructure deployments will face escalating regulatory scrutiny, forcing operators to prioritize social license and architectural integration over sheer vertical capacity.

headlines.title_zh: 犹他大学突破神经接口假肢技术
headlines.title_en: Cutting-edge prosthetics allow researchers to probe the human mind
headlines.author: Jessica Hamzelou
headlines.event_summary_zh: 犹他大学研究团队完成一项创新假肢临床试验，受试者可通过植入神经电极实现假肢的精细操控与感官反馈
headlines.event_summary_en: Researchers at the University of Utah are conducting a clinical trial on advanced neural-interface prosthetics. By implanting electrodes into the nerves of the participant's arm, the technology enables both motorized control and sensory feedback, marking a significant step toward real-world independent use of bionic limbs.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】犹他大学（University of Utah）研究团队在神经工程临床试验环境：通过神经电极植入实现假肢的精细感知与运动反馈，并验证了居家环境下的独立操作能力
【起因与机理】旨在攻克假肢触觉缺失与控制精度难题，同时研究脑神经反馈对假肢操控的影响
【核心事实细节】基于神经电极植入的闭环操控假肢技术。
【行业影响与走向】研究重点转向神经反馈对假肢性能与大脑塑性的协同影响。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] University of Utah research team: Enabled precise prosthetic control and sensory feedback via nerve-implanted electrodes, validated for independent home use
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To solve limitations in tactile feedback and motor precision, and to study neuroplasticity in prosthetic integration
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Closed-loop prosthetic technology based on implanted neural electrodes.
[Key Position & Outlook] Focus shifting to neuroplasticity and the synergy between sensory feedback and motor control.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此项研究标志着假肢技术从单纯的机械代偿转向神经深度整合阶段，电极植入的生物相容性与长期信号稳定性是后续产业化转化的核心技术护城河。商业端需关注其在神经反馈闭环系统上的突破，这直接决定了未来生物医学工程领域中人机融合形态的可及性。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This research signifies a transition from passive mechanical prosthetics to deep neural integration. The technical moat lies in the biocompatibility and long-term signal stability of the implanted electrodes, which will define the commercial viability of future human-machine fusion platforms.

headlines.title_zh: 外资单月抛售台股创纪录，AI泡沫担忧加剧
headlines.title_en: Foreign Funds on Pace for Record Taiwan Stock Exodus in AI Rout
headlines.author: Bloomberg
headlines.event_summary_zh: 外资11月净卖出台湾股票规模达1.09万亿新台币，刷新历史纪录，反映全球资本对AI高估值与半导体供应链不确定性的避险情绪
headlines.event_summary_en: Foreign investors net sold NT$1.09 trillion ($33.1 billion) in Taiwanese stocks in November, hitting a record high and pushing the Taiex index down 21% from its October peak. The sell-off is driven by valuation concerns in AI, heightened US chip export restrictions, and geopolitical tariff risks, resulting in significant capital repatriation.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】全球机构投资者、台湾证券交易所在台湾资本市场：11月净卖出台股创纪录，台币兑美元汇率走低
【起因与机理】AI估值调整、美国芯片禁令与关税不确定性驱动资金避险
【关键数据与实测】外资11月创纪录抛售台股1.09万亿新台币。
【各方立场与态度】主要归因于AI估值修正、美对华芯片禁令及关税预期。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Global institutional investors, Taiwan Stock Exchange (Taiwanese stock market): Record monthly net selling of NT$1.09 trillion
[Root Cause & Mechanism] AI valuation corrections, US chip restrictions, and tariff uncertainties
[Key Metrics] Record foreign selling of NT$1.09 trillion in November.
[Key Position & Outlook] Driven by AI valuation correction and regulatory headwinds.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 作为全球AI硬件制造的战略锚点，台湾市场外资大规模撤离标志着资本已从单纯的增长押注转向审慎的资产负债表重估，尤其是对高额资本开支带来的投资回报率（ROI）疑虑加深。在地缘政治与芯片管制双重夹击下，台系半导体供应链的议价权与利润弹性正面临周期性拐点压力。
headlines.industry_impact_en: As a strategic anchor for global AI hardware, the exodus indicates a shift from aggressive growth bets to cautious balance sheet reassessment, specifically concerning ROI on massive AI capex. Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain is facing a structural cyclical inflection point under the dual pressure of geopolitical friction and intensified export controls.

celebrity.quote_zh:
文是最早相信我们可以使用当时的模型来解决千禧年奖金问题的人之一。

世界上有很多才华横溢的人，但才华横溢，并且拥有正确的信心和勇气，继续推动别人认为不可能的事情，是一件非常有价值的事情，而且相当罕见。

我很感激 OpenAI 的很多人都拥有这种组合。
celebrity.quote_en:
Ven was one of the earliest believers that we could use our then-current model to solve millenium prize problems.

There are a lot of brilliant people in the world, but being brilliant and also having correctly-placed confidence and courage to keep pushing on something that others don't think is possible is a very valuable thing and fairly rare.

I am grateful so many people at OpenAI have this combination.
